svg.text: Electrical criteria and branch circuit intent
Read with the proposed electrical floor plans on E-01 and E-02.
Field-verify existing work and all rough-ins. | CAD rev. 57 | November 2026
2025 California Electrical Code (CEC), Title 24 Part 3, with City of Ventura amendments
under Municipal Code chapter 12.125. Assumes a new permit application in 2026.
Cover qualifying wall space 2 ft or wider so no point measured along the floor line is
more than 6 ft from a receptacle. Include wall space below glazing, with doors and
similar openings breaking the run. Provide a hall receptacle where length is 10 ft or
Use two 20 A small-appliance branches. Cover wall-counter spaces 12 in or wider within
24 in of a receptacle along the wall line. Counter outlets are 44 in AFF at center,
about 7¼ in above the 36¾ in worktop, within the 20 in limit.
Provide a basin receptacle within 3 ft of each basin edge. Keep boxes out of the tub
and shower zone under 406.9(C). Provide the designated 20 A bath, laundry, and garage
branches. Field-check each garage vehicle bay.
Provide GFCI in kitchens, baths, laundry and garage, plus other required locations and
appliances. Locate GFCI reset controls where readily accessible. Provide AFCI where
required. Use listed tamper-resistant receptacles where required.
Field-survey existing devices, service rating and panel location. Complete lighting and
switch layouts, actual circuiting, panel schedule, load calculations, and one-line
diagram to match City checklist BS-007.
Confirm detached-wing permit classification, ADU supply and any kitchen scope. Check
outdoor and service receptacle requirements and lighting or energy-code scope as
Keep boxes clear of pockets, built-ins and window framing. Verify appliance connection
height, accessibility, voltage and cord reach.
Circuit IDs on E-01 and E-02. Verify panel, circuits and loads in the field.
